content: Direct competitor analysis: WigAI (github.com/fabb/WigAI, 41 stars, v0.10.1 Aug 2025) is the ONLY existing project combining AI agent + Bitwig extension. It is a Java .bwextension implementing an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server at http://localhost:61169/mcp. Features implemented: transport control (start/stop), device parameter control for selected device, clip and scene launching. Built with BMAD v2 method. NO analysis layer, NO patch/diff model, NO project memory, NO risk classes, NO undo labels beyond Bitwig native. WigAI explicitly chose MCP (which bw-brain rejects per 'small toolbelt' stance). Other Bitwig community Java extensions: DrivenByMoss (controllers, 763★), BitwigBuddy (drum pattern generation + velocity editing + macros, 29★), bitwig-randomizer (randomization, 49★), openwig (Python algorithmic composition, 39★). None combine analysis + memory + reversible patching. bw-brain's differentiation vs WigAI: patch-first vs direct-mutation; CLI-stable contract vs MCP; analysis/memory layer vs dumb control; local-first copilot vs orchestration surface.
